title: Add KV occupancy trends and context-aware log redaction
author: Aisha Verma
description:
Motivation: We currently only expose coarse KV cache metrics (hit/miss) which makes it hard to diagnose sustained evictions and cache thrash that drive token tail latency and increased per-token cost. This PR introduces a compact set of time-series and dashboard panels that show KV cache occupancy trends, eviction/insert rates, per-tenant occupancy ratio, and a cross-correlation panel between occupancy spikes and token-latency tails.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds runtime metrics emitted by the serving runtime: kv_cache_total_slots, kv_cache_occupied_slots, kv_cache_evictions, kv_cache_inserts, kv_cache_partitioned_occupancy{tenant,shard}. Metrics are exposed with labels to support rollups without increasing cardinality.
- Introduces a lightweight occupancy estimator in the runtime that updates at low frequency (default 10s) to avoid polling overhead. Estimator is opt-in behind a feature flag and off by default for private installs.
- Adds a new observability dashboard (dashboards/kv_occupancy_trends.json) with occupancy sparkline, eviction heatmap, tenant-occupancy percentiles, and a correlation scatter between occupancy and 95p token latency.
- Implements alert tuning: new SLO-friendly alert rule observability/alerts/kv_occupancy_slo.yaml fires only when sustained occupancy > 85% for 5m and eviction rate > 0.5/sec averaged across 1m. Alerts include suggested remediation links and on-call runbook reference.
- Adds context-aware log redaction: a small logging filter (observability/logging/context_redactor.py) that redact PII from prompt/context but preserves a compact token fingerprint and sampling context necessary for post-mortem (sample id, token-cost-bucket, shard). Redaction preserves observability while addressing privacy compliance.
- Adds docs and runbook notes for ops and privacy teams (docs/observability/kv-occupancy.md).

Design notes and tradeoffs:
- To avoid high cardinality we aggregate occupancy per partition/shard and expose percentiles rather than per-invocation labels. The occupancy estimator updates infrequently to minimize CPU overhead on hot paths.
- Context-aware redaction keeps a deterministic token fingerprint (sha256 truncated) plus a sampling_id so that developers can join traces without seeing raw prompt text. The default is conservative (redact-on) for hosted; private installs can enable or disable via feature flag.
- The alert thresholds were calibrated from historical traces (see ENG-4021) and include a rate condition (evictions/sec) to reduce noisy alerts from short bursts.

How to enable / rollout:
- Feature flag: obs.kv_occupancy.enabled = false (default). Ops can flip to true in staging and run the dashboard.
- The occupancy estimator has config knobs: poll_interval_seconds (default 10), min_sample_traffic (default 100 invocations/min).
- Context redaction is behind obs.redaction.mode with values [off, conservative, permissive]. Hosted default = conservative.

Security & privacy review: SEC-118 reviewed the redactor logic and recommended deterministic fingerprinting + single-hop salt per-tenant. We added an integration test that verifies redacted logs contain no raw prompt substrings for a set of training PII patterns.

Testing & validation:
- Unit tests for estimator logic and redactor (telemetry/unit/*).
- Integration run against synthetic workload (bench/perf/kv-occupancy-replay) with comparison dashboards in the PR.
- Load impact measured: ~0.6% CPU on a 16-vCPU serving node when enabled at 10s poll interval.

Rollout plan: stage -> canary (10% of traffic) -> all. Alerts initially set to P0-monitor only (no paging) for 48h, then escalated if stable.

Links: Linear ENG-4021, SEC-118, runbook reference: runbooks/kv-cache-thrash.md

Checklist: - [x] Metrics implemented and registered - [x] Dashboard panels added - [x] Alerts tuned with hysteresis - [x] Privacy review and tests - [x] Docs updated

review_comments: Jonas Lee: Nice instrumentation. Can we ensure the occupancy metric scales for multi-tenant aggregation? Suggest exposing a per-partition_percentile label instead of per-tenant when traffic is small.
Aisha Verma: Good point — switched to partition-level percentiles and added tenant_ratio metric. Updated docs to show aggregation examples.
Marta Ruiz: Security review: confirm that redaction removes known PII and that fingerprints are irreversible. Also request an integration test demonstrating redacted output for sample inputs.
Aisha Verma: SEC-118 provided review and we added deterministic truncation + tenant salt. Integration test added at telemetry/unit/test_redactor.py. Details in PR comment.
Samir Patel: Performance concern: what is the CPU impact at 5s poll interval? We should default to 10s. Also add guard so estimator skips when traffic < min_sample_traffic.
Aisha Verma: Added config guards and adjusted default poll_interval_seconds to 10s. Bench results added to PR description.

release_notes: Add KV cache occupancy metrics and dashboard; new SLO-aware alerts for sustained high occupancy; context-aware log redaction to preserve observability without leaking raw prompts. Opt-in via feature flag.
notes_on_deploy: Enable behind feature flag in staging. Monitor kv_cache_occupied_slots and kv_cache_evictions. Keep alerting in p0-monitor mode for 48h. Privacy team to verify redaction outputs in hosted logs.
